kurzbeschreibung:
**Welcome to Ehrwald – Your Gateway to the Magic of Tirol!**

Nestled in the heart of the **Zillertal Alps**, **Ehrwald** is the perfect starting point for unforgettable adventures in **Tirol**. Whether you're seeking thrilling slopes, serene hiking trails, or cozy mountain charm, this picturesque village has it all.

**Winter Wonderland**
Hit the slopes at **Ahornbahn** or **Ehrwalder Alm**, where world-class ski runs cater to all levels. After a day on the mountain, warm up with a steaming bowl of **Tiroler Gröstl** or a glass of **Apfelstrudel** at one of our rustic **Hütten**. For families, the **Ehrwald Snowpark** and **Ehrwalder Alm** offer endless fun with snow tubing, sledding, and snowy playgrounds.

**Summer Escape**
When the snow melts, **Ehrwald** transforms into a hiker’s paradise. Explore the **Zillertal Valley** with trails like the **Zillertal Höhenweg** or the **Ahornbahn** gondola ride for breathtaking views. Don’t miss the **Ehrwalder Alm**, a traditional alpine dairy farm where you can taste fresh **Käse** and **Speck** while soaking in the crisp mountain air.

**Culinary Delights**
Indulge in **Tiroler specialties** like **Kaiserschmarrn**, **Käsespätzle**, or a hearty **Schweinsbraten** at local **Gasthöfe** and **Bergkneipen**. Pair your meal with a **Tiroler Bier** or a glass of **Veltliner** for the perfect alpine dining experience.

**Culture & Relaxation**
Visit the **Ehrwald Museum** to learn about the village’s history, or unwind in the **Ehrwalder Therme**, a thermal spa with panoramic views of the **Karwendel** and **Zugspitze**. For a taste of local culture, catch a traditional **Schuhplattler** performance or browse the charming shops in the village center.

**Easy Access to Innsbruck**
Just **20 minutes** from **Innsbruck**, **Ehrwald** is the ideal base for exploring **Tirol’s** capital. Take the **Ahornbahn** or drive along the scenic **Zillertal Road** for a seamless journey.

**Plan Your Stay**
With its mix of adventure, relaxation, and authentic **Tiroler** hospitality, **Ehrwald** promises a vacation you’ll remember. Whether you’re here for a weekend or a week, let the magic of the **Zillertal Alps** inspire you!

**Willkommen in Ehrwald – Where Every Season is an Adventure!**
